-- KEY GATE

local function addSnowflake(layer, rng)
    local flake = Instance.new("Frame")
    local size = rng:NextInteger(2, 5)

    flake.Name = "Snowflake"
    flake.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)

    flake.Position = UDim2.new(
        rng:NextNumber(),
        0,
        rng:NextNumber(-0.15, 1),
        0
    )

    local shade = rng:NextInteger(205, 245)

    flake.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(
        shade,
        shade,
        shade
    )

    flake.BackgroundTransparency =
        rng:NextNumber(0.18, 0.58)

    flake.BorderSizePixel = 0
    flake.ZIndex = layer.ZIndex
    flake.Active = false
    flake.Selectable = false

    Instance.new("UICorner", flake).CornerRadius =
        UDim.new(1, 0)

    flake.Parent = layer

    task.spawn(function()
        while flake.Parent do
            local startX = rng:NextNumber(-0.08, 1.08)
            local duration = rng:NextNumber(4.5, 9.5)
            local drift = rng:NextNumber(-0.07, 0.07)

            flake.Position = UDim2.new(
                startX,
                0,
                -0.08,
                0
            )

            local tween = TweenService:Create(
                flake,
                TweenInfo.new(
                    duration,
                    Enum.EasingStyle.Linear
                ),
                {
                    Position = UDim2.new(
                        startX + drift,
                        0,
                        1.08,
                        0
                    )
                }
            )

            tween:Play()
            tween.Completed:Wait()

            if flake.Parent then
                task.wait(rng:NextNumber(0, 0.8))
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function addSnowfall(parent, amount, zIndex)
    local layer = Instance.new("Frame")

    layer.Name = "Snowfall"
    layer.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    layer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    layer.BorderSizePixel = 0
    layer.ClipsDescendants = true
    layer.ZIndex = zIndex or 1
    layer.Active = false
    layer.Selectable = false
    layer.Parent = parent

    local rng = Random.new()

    for _ = 1, amount do
        addSnowflake(layer, rng)
    end

    return layer, rng
end

        UDim.new(0, 10)

        "UIStroke",
        button
    )

    buttonStroke.Color =
        Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)

    buttonStroke.Thickness = 1

    -- Drag the key card from any non-interactive area, but never from
    -- the actual key input field or the check button.
    local keyDragging = false
    local keyDragStart
    local keyStartPosition

    local function pointInsideGuiObject(position, object)
        local objectPos = object.AbsolutePosition
        local objectSize = object.AbsoluteSize

        return
            position.X >= objectPos.X
            and position.X <= objectPos.X + objectSize.X
            and position.Y >= objectPos.Y
            and position.Y <= objectPos.Y + objectSize.Y
    end

    UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(inputObject)
        if SCRIPT_KILLED or inputObject.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            return
        end

        if not pointInsideGuiObject(inputObject.Position, card) then
            return
        end

        -- The key field is deliberately excluded from dragging.
        if pointInsideGuiObject(inputObject.Position, box)
            or pointInsideGuiObject(inputObject.Position, button) then
            return
        end

        keyDragging = true
        keyDragStart = inputObject.Position
        keyStartPosition = card.Position
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inputObject)
        if SCRIPT_KILLED or not keyDragging then
            return
        end

        if inputObject.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            return
        end

        local delta = inputObject.Position - keyDragStart

        card.Position = UDim2.new(
            keyStartPosition.X.Scale,
            keyStartPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            keyStartPosition.Y.Scale,
            keyStartPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end)

    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(inputObject)
        if inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            keyDragging = false
        end
    end)

    local unlocked = false

    local function updateMask()

        local count = #input.Text

        mask.Text =
            count > 0
            and string.rep("•", count)
            or ""

        placeholder.Visible =
            count == 0

        local maxWidth =
            box.AbsoluteSize.X - 32

        local width =
            math.min(mask.TextBounds.X, maxWidth)

        caret.Position =
            UDim2.new(
                0,
                15 + width,
                0.5,
                -11
            )

        caret.Visible =
            input:IsFocused()

    end

    input:GetPropertyChangedSignal(
        "Text"
    ):Connect(function()
        local cleaned = input.Text:gsub("[\r\n]", "")
        if cleaned ~= input.Text then
            input.Text = cleaned
            return
        end
        updateMask()
    end)

    task.spawn(function()

        while gui.Parent do

            if input:IsFocused() then
                caret.Visible =
                    not caret.Visible
            else
                caret.Visible = false
            end

            task.wait(0.5)

        end

    end)

    local function focusKeyInput()

        input:CaptureFocus()

        task.defer(updateMask)

    end

    input.Focused:Connect(function()
        updateMask()
    end)

    input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        caret.Visible = false
    end)

    box.InputBegan:Connect(
        function(inputObject)

            if inputObject.UserInputType ==
                Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

                focusKeyInput()

            end

        end
    )

    local function tryKey()

        local enteredKey = input.Text:lower()
        local validKey = false

        for _, workingKey in ipairs(WORKING_KEYS) do
            if enteredKey == workingKey then
                validKey = true
                break
            end
        end

        if validKey then

            unlocked = true
            button.Text = "UNLOCKED"
            status.Text = ""

            task.wait(0.15)

            gui:Destroy()

        else

            status.Text = "Invalid key"

            input.Text = ""

            updateMask()
            focusKeyInput()

        end

    end

    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(
        tryKey
    )

    mask.InputBegan:Connect(
        function(inputObject)

            if inputObject.UserInputType ==
                Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

                box:CaptureFocus()

            end

        end
    )

    input.FocusLost:Connect(
        function(enterPressed)

            if enterPressed then
                tryKey()
            end

        end
    )

    updateMask()

    repeat
        task.wait()
    until unlocked or SCRIPT_KILLED

end

-- Emergency kill key. This is registered before the key gate so F7
-- can close the script even while the key screen is open.
local killConnection
killConnection = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.F7 then
        return
    end

    SCRIPT_KILLED = true
    TRIGGER_HELD = false
    TRIGGER_TOGGLED = false
    HOST_TRIGGER_ARMED = false

    -- Disconnect this emergency handler too so nothing remains listening.
    if killConnection then
        killConnection:Disconnect()
        killConnection = nil
    end

    -- Stop the render-bound trigger loop as well.
    pcall(function()
        RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("Triggerbot_RenderStep")
    end)

    -- Destroy every UI created by this script.
    for _, name in ipairs({"ModernKeyGate", "MinimalWhitelist"}) do
        local gui = CoreGui:FindFirstChild(name)
        if gui then
            gui:Destroy()
        end
    end
end)

-- =========================================================
-- INITIALIZATION LOADING SCREEN
-- =========================================================
-- The loading artwork is embedded directly into this script.
-- This removes the dependency on manually placing the JPG beside
-- the script. The script writes the image locally when writefile
-- and a supported base64 decoder are available.
local LOADING_IMAGE_FILE = "triggerbot_loading_image.jpg"
local LOADING_IMAGE_B64 = [[]]

local function decodeLoadingImage(data)
    local decoded

    pcall(function()
        if crypt and type(crypt.base64decode) == "function" then
            decoded = crypt.base64decode(data)
        elseif crypt and crypt.base64 and type(crypt.base64.decode) == "function" then
            decoded = crypt.base64.decode(data)
        elseif syn and syn.crypt and type(syn.crypt.base64decode) == "function" then
            decoded = syn.crypt.base64decode(data)
        elseif syn and syn.crypt and type(syn.crypt.base64) == "function" then
            decoded = syn.crypt.base64(data)
        elseif base64 and type(base64.decode) == "function" then
            decoded = base64.decode(data)
        elseif type(base64decode) == "function" then
            decoded = base64decode(data)
        elseif type(base64_decode) == "function" then
            decoded = base64_decode(data)
        end
    end)

    return decoded
end

local function getLoadingImage()
    if type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then
        return nil
    end

    -- Try an already-existing local asset first.
    local ok, asset = pcall(function()
        return getcustomasset(LOADING_IMAGE_FILE)
    end)

    if ok and asset then
        return asset
    end

    -- If it is not already present, create it from the embedded image.
    if type(writefile) == "function" then
        local decoded = decodeLoadingImage(LOADING_IMAGE_B64)

        if decoded then
            local wrote = pcall(function()
                writefile(LOADING_IMAGE_FILE, decoded)
            end)

            if wrote then
                local loaded, newAsset = pcall(function()
                    return getcustomasset(LOADING_IMAGE_FILE)
                end)

                if loaded and newAsset then
                    return newAsset
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local function showLoadingScreen()

    end

    local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", overlay)
    title.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(500, 34)
    title.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.57)
    title.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    title.BackgroundTransparency = 1

    title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245)
    title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    title.TextSize = 23
    title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    title.ZIndex = 3

    local subtitle = Instance.new("TextLabel", overlay)
    subtitle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(500, 24)
    subtitle.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.605)
    subtitle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    subtitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    subtitle.Text = "Initializing services..."
    subtitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
    subtitle.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    subtitle.TextSize = 12
    subtitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    subtitle.ZIndex = 3

    local progressBack = Instance.new("Frame", overlay)
    progressBack.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(450, 8)
    progressBack.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.655)
    progressBack.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    progressBack.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 45)
    progressBack.BorderSizePixel = 0
    progressBack.ZIndex = 3
    Instance.new("UICorner", progressBack).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local progress = Instance.new("Frame", progressBack)
    progress.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
    progress.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245)
    progress.BorderSizePixel = 0
    progress.ZIndex = 4
    Instance.new("UICorner", progress).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local percent = Instance.new("TextLabel", overlay)
    percent.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 24)
    percent.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.695)
    percent.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    percent.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    percent.Text = "0%"
    percent.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245)
    percent.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    percent.TextSize = 13
    percent.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    percent.ZIndex = 3

    local progressTween = TweenService:Create(
        progress,
        TweenInfo.new(2.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
        {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)}
    )
    progressTween:Play()

    local start = os.clock()
    local duration = 2.4
    while gui.Parent and os.clock() - start < duration do
        local alpha = math.clamp((os.clock() - start) / duration, 0, 1)
        local value = math.floor(alpha * 100 + 0.5)
        percent.Text = tostring(value) .. "%"
        task.wait()
    end

    if gui.Parent then
        percent.Text = "100%"
        task.wait(0.12)
        gui:Destroy()
    end
end

showLoadingScreen()

if SCRIPT_KILLED then
    return
end

local function applyAimAssistSettings()
    local radius = tonumber(aimRangeInput.Text)
    if radius then
        AIM_ASSIST_RADIUS = math.floor(math.clamp(radius, 5, 500))
    end
    aimRangeInput.Text = tostring(AIM_ASSIST_RADIUS)

    local strengthLevel = tonumber(aimStrengthInput.Text)
    if strengthLevel then
        strengthLevel = math.floor(math.clamp(strengthLevel, 0, 100))
        AIM_ASSIST_STRENGTH = strengthLevel / 1000
    end

    local displayStrength = math.floor(math.clamp(AIM_ASSIST_STRENGTH * 1000, 0, 100) + 0.5)
    aimStrengthInput.Text = tostring(displayStrength)
end

aimRangeInput.FocusLost:Connect(applyAimAssistSettings)
aimStrengthInput.FocusLost:Connect(applyAimAssistSettings)

local selectedActivator = nil
local activatorPulseUntil = 0
local activatorFireAt = 0
local activatorConnections = {}
local activatorAnimationConnections = {}

local function disconnectActivator()
    for _, c in ipairs(activatorConnections) do
        pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
    end
    for _, c in ipairs(activatorAnimationConnections) do
        pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
    end
    activatorConnections = {}
    activatorAnimationConnections = {}
end

local function isLikelyTracerObject(instance)
    if not instance then
        return false
    end

    -- Beam is the preferred signal. Trail is deliberately excluded because
    -- knife/melee weapons commonly use Trails and would create false shots.
    if instance:IsA("Beam") then
        return true
    end

    if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
        local n = string.lower(instance.Name or "")

        -- Prefer explicit projectile/tracer naming.
        if n:find("tracer", 1, true)
            or n:find("bullet", 1, true)
            or n:find("projectile", 1, true)
            or n:find("bulletline", 1, true)
            or n:find("shotline", 1, true) then
            return true
        end

        -- Fallback for unnamed visual line parts.
        local size = instance.Size
        local smallest = math.min(size.X, size.Y, size.Z)
        local largest = math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z)

        return instance.CanCollide == false
            and instance.Transparency < 1
            and smallest <= 0.20
            and largest >= 3.0
    end

    return false
end

local function getEffectPosition(instance)
    if not instance then
        return nil
    end

    if instance:IsA("Beam") then
        local a0 = instance.Attachment0
        local a1 = instance.Attachment1
        if a0 then return a0.WorldPosition end
        if a1 then return a1.WorldPosition end
    elseif instance:IsA("Attachment") then
        return instance.WorldPosition
    elseif instance:IsA("BasePart") then
        return instance.Position
    end

    local parent = instance.Parent
    if parent and parent:IsA("BasePart") then
        return parent.Position
    end

    return nil
end

local function getNearestPlayerToPosition(position, maxDistance)
    if not position then return nil, math.huge end

    local nearest = nil
    local nearestDistance = maxDistance or math.huge

    for _, candidate in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if candidate ~= LocalPlayer and candidate.Character then
            local root = candidate.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                or candidate.Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
                or candidate.Character:FindFirstChild("Torso")

            if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
                local distance = (root.Position - position).Magnitude
                if distance < nearestDistance then
                    nearest = candidate
                    nearestDistance = distance
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return nearest, nearestDistance
end

local function isOwnedByActivator(player, instance)
    local character = player and player.Character
    if not character or not instance then
        return false
    end

    -- First choice: the game's effect is directly parented to the HOST.
    if instance:IsDescendantOf(character) then
        return true
    end

    if instance:IsA("Beam") then
        local a0 = instance.Attachment0
        local a1 = instance.Attachment1

        if (a0 and a0:IsDescendantOf(character))
            or (a1 and a1:IsDescendantOf(character)) then
            return true
        end
    end

    -- Many Roblox weapons clone their tracer into Workspace instead of
    -- keeping it under the character. In that case, identify the shooter by
    -- the tracer's origin and require the selected HOST to be the nearest
    -- player. This is much stricter than simply checking whether the effect
    -- is close to the HOST.
    local position = getEffectPosition(instance)
    if not position then
        return false
    end

    local nearest = getNearestPlayerToPosition(position, 12)
    return nearest == player
end

local function hostHasMeleeWeapon(player)
    local character = player and player.Character
    if not character then return false end

    for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Tool") then
            local n = string.lower(child.Name or "")
            if n:find("knife", 1, true)
                or n:find("melee", 1, true)
                or n:find("sword", 1, true)
                or n:find("katana", 1, true)
                or n:find("blade", 1, true) then
                return true
            end
        end
    end

    return false
end

local function pulseActivator(player, reason)
    -- The selected HOST is the only player that can ever arm the trigger.
    -- Ignore all shot-like effects while the HOST is holding a melee weapon.
    if SCRIPT_KILLED or not MENU_UNLOCKED or player ~= selectedActivator or not TRIGGER_HELD then
        return
    end

    if hostHasMeleeWeapon(player) then
        HOST_TRIGGER_ARMED = false
        activatorPulseUntil = 0
        activatorFireAt = 0
        return
    end

    -- Add a short reaction delay after the HOST shot is detected.
    -- This is timed from the shot detection itself; it does NOT wait for
    -- the tracer/beam to disappear.
    if not HOST_TRIGGER_ARMED then
        activatorFireAt = os.clock() + (HOST_DELAY_MS / 1000)
    end
    activatorPulseUntil = os.clock()
    HOST_TRIGGER_ARMED = true
    target1Status.Text = "HOST SHOT — TRIGGER ARMED"
end

local function watchActivator(player)
    disconnectActivator()
    activatorPulseUntil = 0
    activatorFireAt = 0
    HOST_TRIGGER_ARMED = false

    if not player then
        target1Status.Text = "Select one HOST. Hold the key before the HOST shoots."
        return
    end

    target1Status.Text = "Watching " .. player.Name .. "..."

    local function watchTracer(instance)
        if not instance or not isLikelyTracerObject(instance) then
            return
        end

        if hostHasMeleeWeapon(player) then
            return
        end

        -- Never use proximity as proof of ownership. Only accept effects
        -- actually belonging to the selected HOST.
        if not isOwnedByActivator(player, instance) then
            return
        end

        pulseActivator(player, "host-tracer")
    end

    local function watchExistingEffect(instance)
        if not instance then return end

        -- Only Beam effects are treated as gunshot tracers. Trails are
        -- intentionally ignored because knives/melee weapons commonly use
        -- them.
        if instance:IsA("Beam") then
            local connection = instance:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
                if instance.Enabled and isOwnedByActivator(player, instance) then
                    pulseActivator(player, "host-tracer-enabled")
                end
            end)
            table.insert(activatorConnections, connection)

            if instance.Enabled and isOwnedByActivator(player, instance) then
                pulseActivator(player, "host-existing-tracer")
            end
        end
    end

    local function watchCharacter(character)
        if not character then return end

        -- Anything under the HOST's character is unambiguously associated
        -- with the selected HOST.
        for _, descendant in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            watchExistingEffect(descendant)
        end

        table.insert(activatorConnections,
            character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
                watchExistingEffect(descendant)
                watchTracer(descendant)
            end)
        )
    end

    -- Workspace-parented tracers are common in weapon systems. Watch both
    -- Beams and explicit tracer/projectile Parts, then associate the effect
    -- with the nearest player at its origin. Only the selected HOST can arm.
    table.insert(activatorConnections,
        workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
            if player ~= selectedActivator then return end
            if not isLikelyTracerObject(descendant) then return end
            if not isOwnedByActivator(player, descendant) then return end

            watchTracer(descendant)

            if descendant:IsA("Beam") then
                watchExistingEffect(descendant)
            end
        end)
    )

    watchCharacter(player.Character)

    table.insert(activatorConnections,
        player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
            task.wait()
            if player == selectedActivator then
                watchActivator(player)
            end
        end)
    )
end

local function updateHostListCanvas()
    task.defer(function()
        if not hostList.Parent then return end
        hostList.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, hostListLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 4)
    end)
end

local function updateHostCheckbox(option, player, selected)
    if not option or not option.Parent then return end
    local box = option:FindFirstChild("CheckBox")
    if not box then return end

    box.BackgroundColor3 = selected and Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 235) or Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 28)
    box.BackgroundTransparency = selected and 0 or 0.05

    local mark = box:FindFirstChild("Mark")
    if mark then
        mark.Visible = selected
    end
end

local function selectActivator(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then
        player = nil
    end

    selectedActivator = player
    HOST_TRIGGER_ARMED = false
    target1Status.Text = player
        and ("HOST: " .. player.Name .. " — " .. (TRIGGER_MODE == "Toggle" and "toggle " or "hold ") .. TRIGGER_KEY_LABEL .. " before the shot.")
        or "Select one HOST. " .. (TRIGGER_MODE == "Toggle" and "Toggle " or "Hold ") .. TRIGGER_KEY_LABEL .. " before the HOST shoots."

    if player then
        watchActivator(player)
    else
        disconnectActivator()
    end
end

local function rebuildHostList()
    for _, child in ipairs(hostList:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TextButton") then
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end

    local query = string.lower(hostSearchBox.Text or "")

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then
            local haystack = string.lower(player.Name .. " " .. player.DisplayName)
            if query == "" or haystack:find(query, 1, true) then
                local option = Instance.new("TextButton")
                option.Name = "HostOption_" .. player.UserId
                option.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 30)
                option.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22)
                option.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
                option.BorderSizePixel = 0
                option.Text = ""
                option.AutoButtonColor = false
                option.ZIndex = 15
                option.Parent = hostList
                Instance.new("UICorner", option).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)

                local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", option)
                nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -52, 1, 0)
                nameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
                nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                nameLabel.Text = player.DisplayName .. " (@" .. player.Name .. ")"
                nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 235)
                nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                nameLabel.TextSize = 9
                nameLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                nameLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
                nameLabel.ZIndex = 16

                local box = Instance.new("Frame", option)
                box.Name = "CheckBox"
                box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)
                box.Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0.5, -10)
                box.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 28)
                box.BorderSizePixel = 0
                box.ZIndex = 16
                Instance.new("UICorner", box).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)

                local mark = Instance.new("TextLabel", box)
                mark.Name = "Mark"
                mark.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                mark.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                mark.Text = "✓"
                mark.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
                mark.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                mark.TextSize = 13
                mark.Visible = player == selectedActivator
                mark.ZIndex = 17

                updateHostCheckbox(option, player, player == selectedActivator)

                option.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    if SCRIPT_KILLED or not MENU_UNLOCKED then return end
                    selectActivator(player)
                    rebuildHostList()
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    updateHostListCanvas()
end

hostSearchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(rebuildHostList)
hostListLayout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(updateHostListCanvas)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)

    task.defer(rebuildHostList)
end)

local function tryUnlock()
    if SCRIPT_KILLED or MENU_UNLOCKED then
        return
    end

    local enteredKey = string.lower(unlockInput.Text or "")
    enteredKey = enteredKey:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    local validKey = false

    for _, workingKey in ipairs(WORKING_KEYS) do
        local normalizedKey = string.lower(tostring(workingKey))
        normalizedKey = normalizedKey:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")

        if enteredKey == normalizedKey then
            validKey = true
            break
        end
    end

    if validKey then
        MENU_UNLOCKED = true
        unlockStatus.Text = "ACCESS GRANTED"
        unlockButton.Text = "UNLOCKED"

        task.wait(0.12)

        if unlockPanel.Parent then
            unlockPanel:Destroy()
        end

        if unlockImage.Parent then
            unlockImage:Destroy()
        end

        triggerSection.Visible = true
        speedSection.Visible = true

        -- Show the corner anime image only after the key screen is finished.
        if cornerAnimeImage.Parent then
            cornerAnimeImage.Visible = true
        end

        task.defer(function()
            if SCRIPT_KILLED or not MENU_UNLOCKED then
                return
            end
            triggerSection.Visible = true
            refreshHostUI()
        end)
    else
        unlockStatus.Text = "INVALID KEY"
        unlockInput.Text = ""
        unlockInput:CaptureFocus()
    end
end

unlockButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(tryUnlock)

unlockInput.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
    if enterPressed then
        tryUnlock()
    end
end)

    if unlockInput.Parent and not SCRIPT_KILLED then

    if TRIGGER_BIND_LISTENING then

    if gameProcessed then return end

    local matches = (TRIGGER_KEY and input.UserInputType == TRIGGER_KEY)
        or (TRIGGER_KEYCODE ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown and input.KeyCode == TRIGGER_KEYCODE)

    if matches then
        if TRIGGER_MODE == "Toggle" then
            TRIGGER_TOGGLED = not TRIGGER_TOGGLED
            TRIGGER_HELD = TRIGGER_TOGGLED
            if not TRIGGER_HELD then
                HOST_TRIGGER_ARMED = false
                AIM_ASSIST_TARGET = nil
            end
        else
            TRIGGER_HELD = true
            TRIGGER_TOGGLED = false
        end
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if SCRIPT_KILLED or not MENU_UNLOCKED then return end

    local matches = (TRIGGER_KEY and input.UserInputType == TRIGGER_KEY)
        or (TRIGGER_KEYCODE ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown and input.KeyCode == TRIGGER_KEYCODE)

        AIM_ASSIST_TARGET = nil

            target1Status.Text = "HOST: " .. selectedActivator.Name .. " — " .. (TRIGGER_MODE == "Toggle" and "toggle " or "hold ") .. TRIGGER_KEY_LABEL .. " before the shot."
        end
    end
end)

setTriggerBinding = function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
            return false

        TRIGGER_KEY = nil
        TRIGGER_KEYCODE = input.KeyCode

        TRIGGER_KEY = input.UserInputType
        TRIGGER_KEYCODE = Enum.KeyCode.Unknown
        TRIGGER_KEY_LABEL = input.UserInputType.Name

    TRIGGER_HELD = false

        target1Status.Text = "HOST: " .. selectedActivator.Name .. " — " .. (TRIGGER_MODE == "Toggle" and "toggle " or "hold ") .. TRIGGER_KEY_LABEL .. " before the shot."

-- =========================================================
-- DRAGGING + RESIZING
-- =========================================================

local resizeHandle

local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition

local resizing = false
local resizeStart
local originalSize

local function pointInsideGuiObject(position, object)
    if not object or not object.Parent then
        return false
    end

    local objectPos = object.AbsolutePosition
    local objectSize = object.AbsoluteSize

    return
        position.X >= objectPos.X
        and position.X <= objectPos.X + objectSize.X
        and position.Y >= objectPos.Y
        and position.Y <= objectPos.Y + objectSize.Y
end

-- Startup size is also the minimum allowed size.
-- Users can resize larger, but never smaller than this.
local MIN_WIDTH = 300
local MIN_HEIGHT = 650

local function pointInsideCard(position)

    local cardPos =
        wlCard.AbsolutePosition

    local cardSize =
        wlCard.AbsoluteSize

    return
        position.X >= cardPos.X
        and position.X <=
            cardPos.X + cardSize.X
        and position.Y >= cardPos.Y
        and position.Y <=
            cardPos.Y + cardSize.Y

end

local function isOverResizeHandle(position)

    if not resizeHandle then
        return false
    end

    local handlePos =
        resizeHandle.AbsolutePosition

    local handleSize =
        resizeHandle.AbsoluteSize

    return
        position.X >= handlePos.X
        and position.X <=
            handlePos.X + handleSize.X
        and position.Y >= handlePos.Y
        and position.Y <=
            handlePos.Y + handleSize.Y

end

-- =========================================================
-- RESIZE HANDLE
-- =========================================================

resizeHandle =
    Instance.new(
        "Frame",
        wlCard
    )

resizeHandle.Name =
    "ResizeHandle"

resizeHandle.Size =
    UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)

resizeHandle.Position =
    UDim2.new(
        1,
        -20,
        1,
        -20
    )

resizeHandle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
resizeHandle.BorderSizePixel = 0
resizeHandle.ZIndex = 20
resizeHandle.Active = true

-- =========================================================
-- THREE-DOT RESIZE DESIGN
-- =========================================================

for i = 0, 2 do

    local dot =
        Instance.new(
            "Frame",
            resizeHandle
        )

    dot.Name =
        "ResizeDot"

    dot.Size =
        UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4)

    dot.Position =
        UDim2.new(
            0,
            5 + i * 5,
            0,
            15 - i * 5
        )

    dot.BackgroundColor3 =
        Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 190)

    dot.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
    dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
    dot.ZIndex = 21
    dot.Active = false

    Instance.new(
        "UICorner",
        dot
    ).CornerRadius =
        UDim.new(1, 0)

end

-- =========================================================
-- START DRAG / RESIZE
-- =========================================================

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(
    function(input)

        if SCRIPT_KILLED then
            return
        end

        if input.UserInputType ~=
            Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            return
        end

        if isOverResizeHandle(
            input.Position
        ) then

            resizing = true
            resizeStart = input.Position
            originalSize = wlCard.AbsoluteSize

            return
        end

        if pointInsideCard(
            input.Position
        ) then

            -- Search/input fields must never start panel dragging.
            -- The rest of the card remains draggable as before.
            if pointInsideGuiObject(input.Position, hostSearchBox)
                or pointInsideGuiObject(input.Position, hostList)
                or pointInsideGuiObject(input.Position, triggerKeyButton)
                or pointInsideGuiObject(input.Position, speedInput)
                    or pointInsideGuiObject(input.Position, aimAssistSection) then
                return
            end

            if unlockInput and unlockInput.Parent
                and pointInsideGuiObject(input.Position, unlockInput) then
                return
            end

            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPosition = wlCard.Position

        end

    end
)

-- =========================================================
-- MOUSE MOVEMENT
-- =========================================================

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(
    function(input)

        if SCRIPT_KILLED then
            return
        end

        if input.UserInputType ~=
            Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            return
        end

        if resizing then

            local delta =
                input.Position - resizeStart

            local newWidth =
                math.max(
                    MIN_WIDTH,
                    originalSize.X + delta.X
                )

            local newHeight =
                math.max(
                    MIN_HEIGHT,
                    originalSize.Y + delta.Y
                )

            wlCard.Size =
                UDim2.fromOffset(
                    newWidth,
                    newHeight
                )

            return
        end

        if dragging then

            local delta =
                input.Position - dragStart

            wlCard.Position =
                UDim2.new(
                    startPosition.X.Scale,
                    startPosition.X.Offset
                        + delta.X,

                    startPosition.Y.Scale,
                    startPosition.Y.Offset
                        + delta.Y
                )

        end

    end
)

-- =========================================================
-- END DRAG / RESIZE
-- =========================================================

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(
    function(input)

        if SCRIPT_KILLED then
            return
        end

        if input.UserInputType ==
            Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

            dragging = false
            resizing = false

        end

    end
)

if MENU_UNLOCKED then

end

-- =========================================================
-- TRIGGERBOT
-- =========================================================

local getPlayerFromCharacter = Players.GetPlayerFromCharacter
local lastTargetCharacter = nil
local lastTargetPlayer = nil
local targetPlayerCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local function getPlayerFromTargetFast(target)
    if not target then
        lastTargetCharacter = nil
        lastTargetPlayer = nil
        return nil
    end

    local character = target.Parent

    if not character or not character:IsA("Model") then
        character = target:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    end

    if not character then
        lastTargetCharacter = nil
        lastTargetPlayer = nil
        return nil
    end

    if character == lastTargetCharacter then
        return lastTargetPlayer
    end

    lastTargetCharacter = character

    local cached = targetPlayerCache[character]
    if cached ~= nil then
        lastTargetPlayer = cached ~= false and cached or nil
        return lastTargetPlayer
    end

    local player = getPlayerFromCharacter(Players, character)
    targetPlayerCache[character] = player or false
    lastTargetPlayer = player

    return player
end


local function isTargetKnocked(character, humanoid)
    if not character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
        return true
    end

    -- Common KO/downed value patterns.
    local bodyEffects = character:FindFirstChild("BodyEffects")
    if bodyEffects then
        for _, name in ipairs({"K.O", "KO", "Knocked", "Downed"}) do
            local value = bodyEffects:FindFirstChild(name)
            if value and value:IsA("BoolValue") and value.Value then
                return true
            end
        end
    end

    -- Also support games that store the state as an attribute.
    for _, name in ipairs({"K.O", "KO", "Knocked", "Downed"}) do
        if character:GetAttribute(name) == true then
            return true
        end
    end

    -- Ragdoll/knock states used by many character controllers.
    local state = humanoid:GetState()
    if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead
        or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
        or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
        or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding then
        return true
    end

    return false
end

local function getAimAssistTarget(camera)
    local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
    local screenCenter = Vector2.new(viewport.X * 0.5, viewport.Y * 0.5)
    local bestPart = nil
    local bestDistance = AIM_ASSIST_RADIUS

    for _, candidate in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if candidate ~= LocalPlayer then
            local character = candidate.Character
            local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local torso = character and (
                character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
                or character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
                or root
            )

            if humanoid and not isTargetKnocked(character, humanoid) and torso and torso:IsA("BasePart") then
                local screenPos, visible = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(torso.Position)
                if visible and screenPos.Z > 0 then
                    local distance = (Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - screenCenter).Magnitude
                    if distance < bestDistance then
                        -- Do not assist through solid map geometry.
                        local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
                        rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                        rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
                            LocalPlayer.Character,
                            character
                        }

                        local direction = torso.Position - camera.CFrame.Position
                        local blocked = workspace:Raycast(
                            camera.CFrame.Position,
                            direction,
                            rayParams
                        )

                        if not blocked then
                            bestDistance = distance
                            bestPart = torso
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return bestPart
end

RunService:BindToRenderStep("Triggerbot_RenderStep", Enum.RenderPriority.Input.Value + 1, function()
    if SCRIPT_KILLED or not MENU_UNLOCKED or not selectedActivator then
        return
    end

    -- While the trigger key is held, make a very small correction toward the
    -- nearest visible body/torso target near the crosshair. Releasing the key
    -- immediately stops the correction.
    if AIM_ASSIST_ENABLED and TRIGGER_HELD then
        local assistCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if assistCamera then
            -- If the locked target dies/gets knocked, stop the assist immediately.
            -- Do not retarget another player while the trigger is still held.
            if AIM_ASSIST_TARGET then
                local oldCharacter = AIM_ASSIST_TARGET.Parent
                local oldHumanoid = oldCharacter and oldCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                if not oldHumanoid or isTargetKnocked(oldCharacter, oldHumanoid) then
                    AIM_ASSIST_TARGET = nil
                    return
                end
            end

            -- Acquire a target only when we do not already have one.
            if not AIM_ASSIST_TARGET then
                AIM_ASSIST_TARGET = getAimAssistTarget(assistCamera)
            end

            if AIM_ASSIST_TARGET then
                local targetCharacter = AIM_ASSIST_TARGET.Parent
                local targetHumanoid = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                if targetHumanoid and not isTargetKnocked(targetCharacter, targetHumanoid) then
                    if AIM_ASSIST_STRENGTH > 0 then
                        local cameraPosition = assistCamera.CFrame.Position
                        local desired = CFrame.lookAt(cameraPosition, AIM_ASSIST_TARGET.Position)
                        assistCamera.CFrame = assistCamera.CFrame:Lerp(desired, AIM_ASSIST_STRENGTH)
                    end
                else
                    AIM_ASSIST_TARGET = nil
                end
            end
        end
    else
        -- Releasing the trigger resets the lock so a new target can be acquired.
        AIM_ASSIST_TARGET = nil
    end

    -- A HOST shot arms the triggerbot. The trigger key must also be held.
    -- Releasing the trigger key clears the arm, so another HOST shot is
    -- required before it can activate again.
    if not HOST_TRIGGER_ARMED or not TRIGGER_HELD then
        return
    end

    if hostHasMeleeWeapon(selectedActivator) then
        HOST_TRIGGER_ARMED = false
        activatorPulseUntil = 0
        activatorFireAt = 0
        return
    end

    -- Wait a small amount after the HOST shot is detected before the first
    -- trigger click. This does not depend on the beam/tracer disappearing.
    if os.clock() < activatorFireAt then
        return
    end

    -- Use the camera ray as the primary target check. This is more reliable
    -- than Mouse.Target when the target moves or the cursor is over an
    -- accessory/transparent part. Fall back to Mouse.Target if needed.
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then return end

    local character
    local player
    local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
    local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(viewport.X * 0.5, viewport.Y * 0.5)
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character}

    local result = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 2000, params)
    local target = result and result.Instance or Mouse.Target

    if not target or not target:IsA("BasePart") then
        lastTargetCharacter = nil
        lastTargetPlayer = nil
        return
    end

    local ancestor = target.Parent
    while ancestor do
        if ancestor:IsA("Model") then
            local candidate = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(ancestor)
            if candidate then
                character = ancestor
                player = candidate
                break
            end
        end
        ancestor = ancestor.Parent
    end

    if not character or not player then
        lastTargetCharacter = nil
        lastTargetPlayer = nil
        return
    end

    -- Always use NORMAL targeting: the exact BasePart under the crosshair
    -- is accepted; there are no head-only or torso-only modes.
    local targetPart = target

    if not targetPart:IsA("BasePart") then
        lastTargetCharacter = nil
        lastTargetPlayer = nil
        return
    end

    if not player or player == LocalPlayer then
        return
    end

    -- There is NO Target 2 whitelist/blacklist. Every other player is a
    -- valid target; Target 2 is simply whoever the crosshair is on.
    mouse1press()
    mouse1release()

    -- Keep the trigger active until the Target 1 activation window expires.
    -- This makes one detected shot turn the triggerbot on rather than
    -- producing only one click.
end)
